goal: A nut (an acorn), one object, large in the middle of the picture on a plain light background, for a tracing practice line.

Ignore the gray background and the shadow: do not copy them. Draw the same acorn with the same shape, the same colors, and the same proportions as in picture 1, as a smooth, clean, bright, soft, round 3D render with a plain white background. The picture to make: a square picture of exactly ONE acorn, large in the middle, filling most of the square, seen from the front-right (a three-quarter view), upright. Exactly one acorn: no second one, no copies, and nothing else in the picture. The background is plain white and empty, with at most a very soft shadow under the object. The page text is context only: do not draw any text. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos. The picture is for young children and is rated G.
linePrompt: Picture 1 is a 3D-rendered children's book picture of one object. Convert picture 1 to line art for a student book: thick, even black lines (about three times a normal outline), simple closed shapes that a 5-year-old can color, on pure white. This object has no eyes and no face: draw no eyes, no pupils, and no face anywhere.  Every line inside the object ends on another line, with no loose ends. Draw only the object: no ground line, no shadow, no background shapes. Do not draw any text, letters, or numbers.
